summary: Sempra filed a preliminary prospectus supplement on Form 424B5 to offer floating rate notes due 2028. The notes are unsecured, unsubordinated obligations ranking equally with existing debt. Interest is based on Compounded SOFR plus a spread. The proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes. The offering is underwritten by BMO Capital Markets and Academy Securities. No redemption is permitted before maturity. The notes will not be listed on any exchange. This is a routine debt offering, not a special situation.
